title: evidence odeslaného a řádka o každém běhu
interface: final class Drupal\api_csobrec\Service\SentLedger. Constructor (\Drupal\Core\Database\Connection $database, \Drupal\Component\Datetime\TimeInterface $time). Tables are api_csobrec_odeslano (id, hovor, fronta, davka, odeslano) with a unique key on hovor, and api_csobrec_davka (id, den, jmeno, hovoru, nahrano, bajtu, zalozeno, stav, chyba) — see api_csobrec.install. Timestamps come from $time->getRequestTime(). wasSent(string $call): bool. alreadySent(array $calls): array returns the subset present in api_csobrec_odeslano; an empty input returns [] without asking the database, and thousands of ids must work — ask in chunks of at most 500, because one statement with thousands of placeholders is refused by the database and a backfill over a long outage asks about exactly that many. record(string $batch, array $rows): int — each row is ['hovor' => string, 'fronta' => string]; a row missing or emptying either key is \InvalidArgumentException, and so is an empty $rows, with nothing written in either case. Insert ignoring conflicts on hovor, so a call keeps the batch it first went out in — rewriting that would make the ledger lie about what ČSOB received. Returns how many rows were NEW. openBatch(\DateTimeImmutable $day, string $name, int $calls): int inserts a api_csobrec_davka row with den = Y-m-d, jmeno, hovoru = $calls, nahrano = 0, bajtu = 0, zalozeno = request time, stav = 'bezi', chyba = NULL, and returns its id. finishBatch(int $id, int $uploaded, int $bytes): void sets stav = 'odeslano', nahrano and bajtu. failBatch(int $id, string $error): void sets stav = 'chyba' and chyba = $error. skipBatch(int $id, string $why): void sets stav = 'preskoceno' and chyba = $why — a day with nothing to send and a broken run must not look the same in the overview. All three throw \InvalidArgumentException for an id that is not in the table. lastBatchOfDay(\DateTimeImmutable $day): ?array returns the latest row of that day as an associative array (order by zalozeno then id, descending), or NULL. counts(): array returns ['hovoru' => int, 'davek' => int]. Everything here is identifiers and counts: no phone numbers, no names, no policy numbers.
